description: The Open Energy Platform (OEP) is a community database and toolset for making energy system modelling transparent, part of the Open Energy Family and hosted by the Reiner Lemoine Institut. The home page read on 2026-09-26 states that all contributors publish datasets under an open licence so that they can be downloaded and reused, and that users can upload their own data. Around the database it offers scenario bundles that link scenarios, the models used to produce them and their data; framework and model factsheets; the Open Energy Knowledge Graph with a SPARQL endpoint; the Open Energy Ontology with a viewer and search; an academy of tutorials; a REST API for downloading and publishing data; and related tools such as Open MaStR (German plant register access) and eGon. The page carries an SPDX CC0-1.0 identifier for the site. Coverage is mostly German and European modelling data, although the platform is open to any region. Caveats: content and metadata quality vary by contributor. Simulation uses are finding and reusing input data and scenario results for energy system models and annotating model data with the ontology. Related records: data-marktstammdatenregister-mastr-germany is the register that Open MaStR accesses.
